These commands are available three ways — in the FREE-WILi GUI app, in a serial
terminal, and on the device itself. See
[Connecting it to a computer](../start-here/connecting.md) for how to reach them.

> **Note:** These settings live on the display CPU but are stored and saved by the main processor.

## Double Click Ms

Button double-click window in milliseconds (currently inert; the display uses a compile-time window)

**How to use it** — press `c`.

**What you enter** — `value`.

## Roku Gui Control

Allow a Roku remote to drive the display GUI buttons

**How to use it** — press `r`.
